exposure: Dural puncture epidural technique using a 27-gauge Whitacre needle
cohort: 76 healthy nulliparous parturients undergoing labor epidural analgesia.
finding: Dural puncture epidural technique using a 27-gauge Whitacre needle provides faster onset of labor epidural analgesia compared to the standard technique, without increasing the need for additional boluses or negatively impacting labor progress or maternal outcomes.
